pages.text: Entity wagons collide with Sable structures. Boarding space and seated-passenger clearance also consider external physical structures. Wagons travel using their own movement and collision system.

Assemble jacks and block-form parts in the normal world. For use around Sable structures, assemble the wagon into an entity first.$(br2)Physicalizing a component, or placing it on a structure, dismantles and recovers it. A box or jack also releases connected equipment, cargo and container contents.
